title: Automated, structured Recall Knowledge per enemy
summary: Give Recall Knowledge real functional automation, beyond cosmetic renaming, so the GM can control exactly what information about a given enemy gets delivered to players immediately, per degree of success.
description: Called out as deserving special attention distinct from the general cosmetic terminology reflavor: if Recall Knowledge is automated, the GM gets direct control over exactly what information players receive about a given enemy, delivered immediately rather than looked up/adjudicated live. This lines up closely with the design bible's existing Sensor Operator ground role ('Recall Knowledge checks reveal the Claimant's weaknesses, resistances, immunities. Each success = one true fact the pilot can act on.') — this idea is asking for that mechanism to actually be built/automated with structured per-creature data, rather than left as manual GM adjudication each time.
sourceContext: User planning message, 2026-08-22 — large worldbuilding/tooling brain-dump.
openSubQuestions: Data shape for a creature's structured Recall Knowledge reveals per degree of success — likely a new optional field on creature.schema.json/combatStatblock (or on the sensor-operator ground-role check itself), not designed yet.
How this surfaces at the table — an inline check result, a GM-panel button, a chat card?
